description: This file defines the LeaveEntitlementReport class, a controller for generating leave entitlement reports in the OrangeHRM system. It extends AbstractVueController and uses traits and services to prepare data for rendering a Vue component.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementReport
classes.description: Controller class for managing leave entitlement report view, preparing data for the Vue component.

methods.name: getLocationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of LocationService.

methods.name: getCompanyStructureService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of CompanyStructureService.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and sets up the Vue component before rendering, including subunits, locations, and leave period information.
